summary: Comprehensive testing of NEW GGS features: Seller Review System and Chat Reporting. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing confirms all features working: Review submission with 1-5 star rating, seller response to reviews, chat reporting with reason selection, Admin Dashboard Chat Reports tab.

backend: POST /api/reviews - Create review with 1-5 star rating
POST /api/reviews/{review_id}/reply - Seller can respond to review
Seller rating_avg and rating_count updated after review
GET /api/reviews/my-reviews - User sees reviews they left
POST /api/chat-reports - All reasons accepted (spam, harassment, scam, inappropriate, other)
GET /api/admin/chat-reports - Admin gets all chat reports
Non-admin blocked from viewing chat reports (403)
Non-admin blocked from resolving chat reports (403)
frontend: Product Detail page - 'Seller Reviews' section visible
Product Detail page - Star rating display (1-5 stars)
Product Detail page - Review count and average rating shown
Product Detail page - Individual reviews with reviewer name, date, comment
Product Detail page - 'Write a Review' button (when applicable)
Review Modal - Star rating selector (clickable stars)
Messages page - Report Chat button (Flag icon) in chat header
Report Chat Modal - Reason dropdown (spam, harassment, scam, inappropriate, other)
Report Chat Modal - Additional details textarea
Report Chat Modal - Submit Report button
Admin Dashboard - 'Chat Reports' tab in navigation
Admin Dashboard - Chat Reports list with pending reports
Admin Dashboard - Report cards show reason, reported user, reporter, date, details
Admin Dashboard - 'Mark Resolved' and 'Dismiss' action buttons
Admin Dashboard - Filter dropdown (All, Pending, Resolved, Dismissed)

critical_code_review_comments: Note: The endpoint for seller reply is /api/reviews/{review_id}/reply (not /respond as mentioned in request)
Review system correctly updates seller's rating_avg and rating_count after each review
Chat reports are stored in 'chat_reports' collection, separate from 'flagged_messages' (auto-flagged by profanity filter)
Added ChatReportsManagement component to AdminDashboard.js for viewing user-reported chats
seed_data_creation: Created test reviews and chat reports during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features verified: 1) Seller Review System - POST /api/reviews creates review with 1-5 stars, GET /api/reviews/seller/{id} and /api/reviews/listing/{id} fetch reviews, POST /api/reviews/{id}/reply allows seller response. Reviews update seller's rating_avg and rating_count. 2) Chat Reporting - POST /api/chat-reports allows users to report conversations with reasons (spam, harassment, scam, inappropriate, other). Admin can view reports at GET /api/admin/chat-reports and resolve/dismiss via PUT /api/admin/chat-reports/{id}/review. Added ChatReportsManagement component to Admin Dashboard.
